Abandon Trident to save billions for public services, We believe the Trident nuclear programme is dangerous, unnecessary and over expensive, especially when public finances are stretched to breaking point. Trident development, deployment and renewal should be stopped immediately., The money saved could be used for the NHS and social services. These services desperately need to be well funded.

Reinstate the two year energy price guarantee, Honour the two year energy price ‘guarantee’ that we were promised. , We were promised frozen energy prices for 2 years! Many of us (and not just the ‘most vulnerable’) were facing tough decisions on finances before this came into play. Those tough decisions are now back in the pipeline and it is not just those with the lowest incomes that will struggle - many of us have mortgages that are a commitment we can’t just drop - meaning the ‘eat or heat’ concern is very real.

Free flu jabs for nursery practitioners and teachers., Child service providers work frontline with children of all ages and in close contact. We don’t receive free flu jabs however other health providers do eg. carers. Practitioners working with children do the same caring duties. This results in staff sickness meaning nurseries/schools are shortstaffed, Personally, I know many people that will sign this petition who do and do not work in nurseries as they believe we should be entitled to a free flu jab for all the work we do, and to protect ourselves and the children to the best of our ability.

New offence of stealing from a charity with a minimum 4-month sentence, I would like there to be a new, specific offence for anyone found guilty of stealing from a charity, including charity shops, with a mandatory custodial sentence of 4 months. In my opinion the Government is not doing enough and needs to crack down on stealing from charities., I strongly believe that the Government should bring in a new offence so that anyone found guilty of stealing from charity and charity shops. 
 
Charity shops are there to help the world become a better place. The amount of items stolen from some charity shops is shocking. What people don’t seem to realise is that these thefts reduce the good that charities can do.

Appoint a dedicated MP to represent the expat community., At the moment British expats are represented by the MP from the constituency they belonged to before they left the UK to live abroad. These MP’s rightly give most of their surgery time to the people who live in their own constituencies and only occasionally engage with expats living abroad., For too long the voices of British people living abroad who see themselves as unpaid Ambassadors has been ignored. There are millions of potential voters who because of being neglected see no reason to engage in the political activity.  This  is a sad reflection of  British politics today.

Set date to withdraw guidance on wearing of face masks by care workers, I would very much appreciate an end date to Government guidance on wearing facemasks in care settings for all staff., I feel that after 2 years and 7 months of continuous masking we at least deserve to know if and when there will be an end date to this.
 
I personally have been finding it extremely difficult and it has unfortunately bought a return of panic attacks making me hyperventilate affecting my breathing.

Establish a dedicated MP to represent the expat community living abroad, At the moment British expats are represented by the MP from the constituency they belonged to before they left the UK to live abroad. I request the UK Government establish a dedicated MP sitting in Parliament, elected by overseas voters, to represent the millions of British expats living abroad., Existing MPs rightly give most of their surgery time to the people who live in their constituency. A dedicated MP for expats should ensure their interests are better represented in Parliament.

Make female sterilisation available on demand to all women, I want the Government to give women the right to be sterilised as and when they want to be, without having to fight for this., Too many women have to debate the fact that they want to be sterilised, with their medical professional. This should be a woman's right to choose, as it is her body, regardless if she is in a relationship or not and not dependant on age, so long as she is classed as an adult.

Allow Day Nursery settings to register for 0% rate VAT, To enable nursery’s to claim VAT back to enable nurseries to provide cheaper childcare for working families, Most nurseries are small business but are unable to claim VAT back, this makes childcare more expensive for parents and can make businesses unsustainable. With a rise in nurseries closing now is the time to change and enable nurseries to claim the VAT back

We want you to change legisation around Clare's Law., We would like them to consider a change to legislation so that a survivor of domestic abuse can access Police information regarding a perpetrator at any stage of the relationship rather than just at the beginning., There is research and evidence to say that ending an abusive relationship is the most dangerous time and the victim at risk of being murdered. We believe that if they had the Police information, this would enable the victim to safeguard themselves against this as they would have knowledge of what the perpetrator is capable of.

Make it illegal for anyone aged over 21 to have sexual relations with under 18s, I would like to see new legislation to better protect our children who are aged 16-17 and therefore still minors. We want the Government to make it illegal for anyone over the age of 21 to have sexual relations with 16-17 olds., We believe some young people are being unknowingly exploited by older people because it’s legal to do so.
 
Most 16 year olds are still in education. Technically it is legal for them to have sexual relations with a 40 year old, providing that it was consensual and that person was not in a “position of trust.” We believe this is not right, and something needs to change. Our children need better protecting in our law!

Hold a referendum on whether to end annual clock changes, We want the Government to put a vote to the public in a referendum on whether to end annual clock changes in March and October. If the public agrees to end this practice, when we return to British Summer Time in 2023, the clocks should be permanently changed and left that way., Every year the clocks are changed twice resulting in disturbances to people's routines and sleep. Both adults and children can be left with sleep and productivity issues around the time of the change. We believe this is an outdated practice which is no longer necessary. In America an act was passed in March 2022 to stop the practice of changing of clocks twice a year and we think we should do the same. Let the public decide.

Fund free public transport for all 16-18 year olds in full-time education, Support both the environment and young people by funding transport to and from education and elsewhere., To ease the burden of the cost of living crisis and help the environment by making it cheaper not to use cars.

Make it unlawful to sell live lobsters in supermarkets and to boil them alive., Lobsters do feel pain and suffer. They don't have automated nervous systems, but marine biologists suggest they feel every second of pain inflicted upon them before death. Studies show lobsters kept in tanks suffer from stress associated with confinement, low oxygen levels and overcrowding., Supermarkets have been selling live lobsters for years. It's wrong and it needs to stop. Let's follow many other countries and make it unlawful to sell live lobsters in supermarkets and to boil them alive. It is extremely cruel, unethical and unnecessary.

Increase funding for the Criminal Cases Review Commission, We want the Government to increase funding for the Criminal Cases Review Commission (CCRC), so they have more resources, funding and manpower to review all possible miscarriages of justice in the criminal courts., We believe that the CCRC is under resourced and that the Government should increase its funding to ensure it is able to identify any miscarriages of justice in the criminal courts.
 
By increasing its funding, the Government can help ensure that people who have been a victim of a miscarriage of justice receive the support, and justice, they deserve.

Amnesty for Undocumented Migrants After 5 years With No Criminal Conviction, A humble and urgent request Amnesty for undocumented Migrants, who entered into the United Kingdom legitimately with hope.  Please kindly grant Amnesty to those who have been living in the United Kingdom for more than five years with no criminal convictions., These highly qualified undocumented people can be a great assets, they have been trained in our homeland can contribute to our economy. And also to reduce the manpower current crisis backlog. These dedicated professionals are being exploited hence to avoid taxation and reducing our economic growth.

Fund increased policing against homophobic hate crimes, We want the Government to do more against homophobic hate crimes, by funding increased policing to tackle these crimes. It’s time we all stood together to help prevent people being attacked and abused just for being themselves., We are in 2022 and it’s time we take steps forwards and not backwards!
 
On halloween I was involved in a homophobic hate crime attack and I now want the Government to do more to prevent homophobic hate crimes. Stand with us and help continue the fight to protect LGBTQ+ rights. We need more funding for increased policing to protect our streets and keep people safe, and take action against those who commit these crimes.

Abandon voter ID OR expand the list of valid ID to avoid voter suppression, Voter fraud is extremely rare and the ID measures introduced under the Elections Bill are unnecessary and anti-democratic. Either withdraw the ID requirement or expand the list to include things like the CitizenCard and Post Office Pass Card to ensure equality of access to the democratic process., The list of valid ID for voters is heavily biased away from a young/less affluent demographic and instead favours older, car-driving or passport-holding citizens. This is voter suppression and is wholly unacceptable in a democracy. It is a clear attempt to skew results in favour of the ruling party.
Disenfranchising a vast slew of voters is wrong.

Action Against Supermarkets to Donate 'Waste' Food To Food Banks and Charities., To bring forward the 2030 food waste pledge and make supermarkets responsible for all of their food waste, but making sure they dispose of it in a more humane way, thinking of those in need rather than exploiting their profits., Currently, millions of citizens from the United Kingdom are having to choose between heating their own home or putting food on their table. This is no choice that anyone should have to make, at the current time, with the economic crisis, many people have to make this choice.

The Trussell Trust food banks are currently struggling for food and food donations. Supermarkets should be made, by law, to donate any consumable food to these food banks instead of allowing them to dispose of it as waste.

Change the laws surrounding buying and selling of domestic properties., Current laws surrounding the sale and purchase of domestic properties are old and unsuitable for the 21st. century housing market. They are unfair, and allow for buyers to 'pull out' of a purchase without penalty, costing sellers thousands of pounds in fees, which they will have to pay again., Currently, if a person makes an offer on my property for sale, and I accept it, the buyer can pull out of the sale for any reason. Depending of the amount of time elapsed, I would have instructed solicitors who would have done background work and prepared legal documents. In the event of my buyer pulling out, I am financially responsible for all of the costs incurred by my solicitor up to that point. This is unjust. This situation does not happen with Scottish law.

Stop touts bulk buying tickets for immediate resale at exorbitant prices, Having spent two hours trying to purchase tickets for Peter Kay’s tour I found it was sold out. At the same time, I searched for resale tickets to discover sites were immediately offering tickets at significantly higher prices, The mass purchase and resale of event tickets causes a number of issues - 1) it prevents the money going to the artist (in the case of Peter Kay who committed to selling tickets at reasonable prices due to the cost of living crisis and 2) prevents the end user customer from getting a fair deal and 3) precludes families living on limited incomes from attending live events

Investigate UK excess deaths not related to Covid., On the week ending the 28th of October the ONS reported excess deaths were 12.5% above the 5 year average. With only 717 deaths out of 12,861 involving Covid. This alarming excess death percentage, needs investigating by the Government and the root causes laid out in a public report., Commission an independent investigation to look into the underlying causes that have led to and continue to contribute to such a high number of excess deaths in the UK, as a matter of urgency. We fear the trend of high excess deaths will continue, so root causes must be ascertained so that action can be taken to bring excess deaths down.

Immediately provide funding and guidance to local councils to improve recycling, Alongside the Environment Act 2021, the Government pledged to provide funding and guidance to local councils to improve recycling. This has not materialised. We want the Government to provide the promised guidance and funding immediately., The climate crisis cannot be tackled while recyclable waste keeps going to landfill.
 
Without this funding and guidance, local councils will struggle to move ahead and many will simply maintain inadequate recycling systems. Without this funding, too many local councils are unwilling to invest in recycling services for fear of losing money. Without this funding, too many councils cannot afford to make necessary improvements.
 
Guidance and funding are vital for tackling waste in the context of the climate emergency. We need urgent Government action on all aspects of the environment, and this is one key step towards that.

We call upon the Government to hold a Public Inquiry into the impact of Brexit, The benefits that were promised if the UK exited the European Union have not been delivered, so we call upon the Government to hold a Public Inquiry to assess the impact that Brexit has had on this country and its citizens., It is time that the people of this country were told the truth about Brexit, good or bad. We deserve to know how Brexit is impacting on trade, the economy, opportunities for young people and how it has affected the rights of individuals. This can only be done by an independent Public Inquiry, free from ideology and the opinions of vested interests.

Increase funding for early years settings, We believe Government funding for early years settings is too low, and making it difficult to keep these settings open. This will only be more difficult with the increase in minimum wage. Everyone wants childcare standards high, but we believe more funding is needed to achieve this., Some early years settings, especially in deprived areas, rely on early years funding to pay staff, bills and maintain high standards and with the increase in minimum wage some of these businesses may struggle to remain open.
 
Additional Government funding for early years settings should help reduce the pressures on these settings, and we believe is desperately needed.

Cancel The Project for Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs)!, Dismiss any now and the future attempt to transfer the British Pound to being Central bank controlled digital Currency. Keep it in the format it is currently in with plastic and coined money. The public do not want to be using the CBDCs, I feel that the government be able to control the hard workers money in the form of CBDCs by using the Banks to do this. This style of currency will put the hard workers money at risk to the public and it will benefit the government as they'll be able to control people and revoke the public basic human rights

Seek to rejoin the European Environment Agency, We want the Government to seek to rejoin the European Environment Agency (EEA), so that up to date UK environmental information is published alongside that of EU nations, in a clear, transparent and responsible way., EEA environmental data no longer covers the UK, and we believe this has resulted in a reduction in the accessibility of transparent environmental information relating to the UK.
 
We believe the UK's membership of the EEA would mean better access to up to date UK environmental information, which is needed so the public can see how bad the climate and environmental situation is regarding pollution and the spread of various organisms throughout Europe, for example anopheles mosquitoes.

Ban unfair ground rent clauses from leasehold agreements, Developers selling new properties can no longer have unfair ground rent clauses in leases (eg where the ground rent can double every 10 years). This needs to be expanded so all leasehold properties built after 2000 cannot have such unfair ground rent clauses., Doubling ground rents significantly reduce the property's market value. They can make the property unsellable because mortgage lenders are reluctant to approve mortgages and buyers are put off because the scheduled increases can become prohibitive.  For current owners, making the increasing annual payments is challenging, leaving them at risk of default and losing their property because they broke the terms of the lease. This will become more of a problem in the current cost of living crisis.

Fund community mental health hubs for children and young people NOW!, We are calling upon the department for health and social care to set up and establish brand new open access community mental health hubs for children and young people in our local communities. Without such services, people like us will have nowhere to turn in a mental health crisis, We are a group of young people aged between 16-25 from all over Liverpool who access information, advice, guidance & support from a prominent young people’s charity based in Merseyside

The charity have recently informed us that due to “staffing issues” & “lack of funding”, they can no longer accommodate us with the mental health support we need after christmas, therefore they’ve had to axe half of their open access groups for good, including the one we go to and now we have nowhere else to turn

More funded research to be done on Adenomyosis, We want the Government to fund more research for Adenomyosis.

More training to all medical professionals on Womb conditions especially Adenomyosis 

We need action as many of us are suffering with little or no support.,

Regulate slimming companies , I would like to see anyone who approaches a company offering slimming techniques or diets to be required to seen in person by a qualified dietician or doctor first., My fiancée, Hannah has lived with diets since she was a young girl, she is now a woman in her 40's and struggling with bulimia... her weight has gone from a healthy 8.5st to 6.9st... this in main is down to a slimming company who was happy to take her on during the pandemic on  a phone call alone!! I have approached them and because Hannah is no longer paying her fee to them, they do not want to know!! She is now at danger point where her organs could fail, she loves running but is unable too.... she loves food but it is the enemy... so I want to see a change to how these companies work.

Stop calling Brexit a "Democratic decision", The UK is a parliamentary democracy and it is irrational to suppose the electorate did not know that when they voted in the EU referendum. 

We think that the Prime Minister's decision to leave was inconsistent with principles of representation that have guided this nation well for centuries., The well established principles of representation were set out in 1774 by Edmund Burke in his famous speech to the electors of Bristol: representatives have a clear duty to give their best, most unbiased judgement, and to not betray democracy by sacrificing it to public opinion.
 
We believe the Brexit decision is the antithesis of these principles: the result was taken as an authoritative instruction and followed blindly.
 
We think that in a functional democracy, that result should have be taken as a vote of no confidence, which should have been dealt with before anything else. Far from respecting the result, we think that by ignoring this option the electorate have been taken for fools.

Therefore, we want the Government to stop calling Brexit a "Democratic decision".

Require Companies House to verify proof of address before registering a company, I want it to be a legal requirement for Companies House to verify proof of address prior to anyone registering a company at an address. Currently anyone can register a company at any address which can enable fraudulent activity., Make it a legal requirement for proof of address prior to registering a company, which should help stop fraudulent companies being set up.
